author: GitHub
description:
Put on your headphones, open your terminal, and enter the flow state. Join a pixelated Mona eating pancakes while you write code, organize your layers, and merge your new stacked PRs. This chill lofi stream is designed to keep you focused during long coding sessions. Sit back, lower your stress, and keep your pull requests small and stacked.

author: GitHub
description:
Have you ever started with one small feature and ended up with a massive pull request? Large PRs are slower to review, harder to debug, and often lead to misunderstandings. Today, we are announcing GitHub stacked PRs to help you break down your work into clean, manageable layers. Watch this video to see how you can stack your pull requests and merge them one by one or all at once. https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/how-tos/stacked-pull-requests?utm_source=YouTube-launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=stacked-prs-gtm-public-preview-2026
